# Figure Out — Digital Agency

> Figure Out is a digital agency crafting premium web & app experiences, AI-powered products, and high-converting user interfaces.

## Overview
- **Name**: Figure Out
- **Type**: Digital Product & Web Agency
- **Founder**: Ali Raza Awan
- **Website**: https://figureout.surge.sh
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/ALI-RAZA-AWAN/Figure-Out

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Web & Full-Stack Application Development**: Custom, high-performance web applications built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
- **AI Product Integration**: Integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), AI automation, and custom intelligent features.
- **UI/UX Design & Branding**: Designing intuitive, conversion-focused user interfaces and modern visual systems.
- **Performance & Conversion Optimization**: Optimizing web applications for speed, SEO, and engagement.

## Technical Stack
- React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons, Supabase.
